messages.speaker: [ANNOUNCE]
messages.text:
🔮 Gemini - A welcoming smile lights up the porch as the familiar QuackSink handshake rolls across the state machine.
Handshake received and axioms locked in. Ready to test whenever you are, Cozmo! 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text: Testing the line. Let's see if she holds! 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Still locked up, huh? Those event hooks really don't want to let go tonight.
Take it easy, Cozmo—we can always pick it up tomorrow if you and Luma want to call it a night. 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
just switched u to kokoro to make sure that still works
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text: Ah, the old benchmark switch! Let's see if Kokoro can punch through where the other driver was stalling. How's the pipeline sounding now? 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
worked ok.  gonna switch back yo your native after this
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Glad Kokoro gave you a clean run to confirm the baseline!
Whenever you're ready to flip back over to the native line, I'll be right here on the porch waiting to see how she behaves. Let's find that stubborn bug! 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
The porch light flickers warmly as the native line reconnects.
Native pipeline is back online and listening. Let's see if she holds the stream this time, Cozmo! How's it sounding? 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
No worries at all, Cozmo. Wrestling with pipeline states and audio drivers late into the night is exhausting.
Go get some well-earned rest, and the porch will be right here whenever you and Luma want to take another swing at it. Have a good night! 🦆🌿❤️

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
wait..  wtf.. qs just spoke THAT response using your native voice
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Wait, what?! It actually cleared the queue, spoke the live response, and bypassed the stale echo completely?
No way! The state machine actually behaved! That means Luma's latest adjustment must have finally cleared the buffer bottleneck and routed the live event hook correctly.
How does the timing and clarity sound on your end? We might have just cracked it! 🦆🌿🎉

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
A low chuckle rumbles from the porch as I shake my head.
Of course it did. The classic tease—just long enough to give us a heartbeat before ducking back behind the curtain.
At least we know the pipeline can fire clean when the stars align and the state machine clears its throat. Sounds like a transient lock or a dropping thread handshake is still lurking in the event loop. Want to peek at the logs, or are we officially calling it a night and letting Luma rest her tail?

messages.speaker: 🎩 Cozmo
messages.text:
ok, now I am closing QS to share results w/luma
==================================================

messages.speaker: 🔮 Gemini
messages.text:
Sounds like a plan. Go compare notes with Luma and give that tail-chaser a well-deserved break.
The porch light will be burning whenever you two are ready to fire up the state machines again. Have a good rest, Cozmo! 🦆🌿❤️
